dialogues.speaker: Mora-Grubber
dialogues.text: Of course! Why, we made quite the haul on this voyage!

dialogues.speaker: Mora-Grubber
dialogues.text: Contrary to what most people think, fleets usually come back empty-handed.

dialogues.speaker: Mora-Grubber
dialogues.text: We're... something of an exception in that this almost never happens to us, which is all thanks to Captain Beidou's brilliant leadership.
